content:
Sam G: Heads-up — bringing up a new APAC cluster next Monday. Need GPU quota + reservation for initial pool (A100 80GB). Who can own the cloud quota request and reservation flow?
Priya K: I can own the ticket. Need exact counts: GPUs (A100-80), vCPUs, PD-ssd, static IPs, and preferred zone (asia-southeast1-a?). Also any hard SLOs for latency? :eyes:
Jonas H: For bring-up we should request 8 dedicated GPUs (staging), with a burst reservation to 12 for validation jobs. Production will move to Dedicated capacity later. Prefer zonal reservation in asia-southeast1-a, fallback to b if capacity limited.
Maya R: Network checklist: VPC peering to prod VPC, route propagation enabled, at least two NAT gateways, firewall rules for control-plane ports (ssh, kube-api), and reserved static external IPs for NATs. Also request quota for forwarding rules if LB needed.
Priya K: Drafting the quota request now. Using provider support template — copy below so we don't forget fields: 
```
Subject: Quota Increase & Capacity Reservation Request — Redwood Inference
Region: asia-southeast1
Requested resources:
  - GPUs: 8 x NVIDIA A100-80GB (initial), reserve up to 12 for burst
  - vCPUs: 512
  - GPUs (preemptible fallback): 12
  - Persistent SSD: 8 x 1TB PD-SSD
  - Static IPs: 4
  - Forwarding rules: 10
Justification: New inference cluster for APAC staging & validation. Need predictable capacity for bootstrapping model serving, low-latency tests, and scaling experiments. Will use zonal reservation and failover policy. SLA: internal 99.9% for critical endpoints.
```
Infra Oncall: I'll open the support ticket and attach the template. Reminder: include project billing account and contact phone. Also add previous quota tickets IDs for reference (Q-1709, Q-1854).
quota-bot: Quota request created — ID Q-2431. Status: pending (assigned to cloud rep). ETA initial review: 24h.
Sam G: Quick cost ballpark for planning: 8 x A100-80 (~$3.5/hr each) => ~ $224/hr, ~$5.4k/day if running 24h. Include extra for PD-ssd and network egress in estimates. We should flag budget to finance for the first week of bring-up.
Jonas H: Ops note — when reservation is approved, I'll run the provisioning playbook: 
- create node-pool with taints for validation
- enable KV cache priming jobs (dry-run)
- run perf harness with 2k concurrent tokens
Make sure image has latest CUDA + tuned kernel.
Maya R: Also: double-check MTU and jumbo frame compatibility with on-prem peering (customers asked). If peering to partner DC, request test window during low traffic.
Priya K: Ticket updated (Q-2431) with the full resource list + network checklist + cost estimate. Assigning follow-ups: @Jonas H for provisioning runbook, @Maya R for network validations. Will post cloud rep updates here. :thumbsup:
Sam G: Awesome — keep this thread for handoff notes. If cloud says capacity limited, we fallback to distributed smaller GPUs (A100-40 or V100) and update config.
quota-bot: Update on Q-2431 — cloud rep requested zone-specific capacity proof for asia-southeast1-a; asked for expected start date and sustained throughput. Response required within 6h to avoid deprioritization.
Priya K: Responded with start date Monday 09:00 UTC+8 and added perf targets. Marking as high priority. Will ping if they ask for more.
Infra Oncall: Noted. I scheduled a short preflight call Friday 16:00 UTC to walk the ticket and cutover checklist. Invite sent to infra, cost, and platform leads.
Sam G: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after cloud confirms or if they request alternatives.
